title: Keyboard Accessibility & Focus Management
objectives: Test any component with keyboard only
Manage focus on dialogs and route changes
Keep focus visible instead of removing outlines

examples.name: focus.css

exercise.prompt: A modal opens. Rank focus duties: "trap Tab inside the modal", "move focus to the modal", "restore focus to the trigger on close", "leave focus on body".
hints: Focus must enter the dialog, stay inside while open, and return on close.
Focus on body leaves keyboard users lost in the page behind.

options: removing the only focus indicator keyboard users have
questions.explanation: If you remove the outline, provide an equally visible alternative (:focus-visible styles).

questions.prompt: After closing a dialog, focus should…
options: return to the element that opened it
jump to the top of the page
questions.explanation: Restoring focus continues the user’s journey where they left it.
